_comment: User-editable model manifest. Edit url / filename / version / sha256 as needed BEFORE launching, or use the app's 'Locate existing file' button to point at models you already downloaded. A good curated list of LTX-2 download links: https://github.com/wildminder/awesome-ltx2

models.name: LTX-2.3 22B Distilled Transformer (fp8)
models.note: Main video diffusion model. See awesome-ltx2 for the current download link.

models.name: Gemma 3 12B IT Text Encoder (fp4 mixed)
models.note: Primary text encoder used by DualCLIPLoader.

models.name: LTX-2.3 Tiny VAE (taeltx2_3)
models.note: Tiny VAE used for the live preview (ModelPreviewOverrideKJ).

models.name: LTX-2.3 Spatial Upscaler x2 (v1.1)
models.note: Stage-2 latent spatial upscaler. Latest v1.1 on huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3.

models.name: BandIt Plus — Cinematic Audio Separation (DnR)
models.note: Optional (~142 MB). Only needed for the 'Remove background music' option. Splits audio into speech/music/effects and drops the music (keeps dialogue + SFX). BandIt Plus checkpoint from ZFTurbo's Music-Source-Separation-Training. No official single-file URL — use 'Locate existing file', or fetch model_bandit_plus_dnr_sdr_11.47.chpt via the MSST model list (github.com/ZFTurbo/Music-Source-Separation-Training).
